PubMed affiliation mining (neurosurgery + Scott & White + Temple, 2014-2026, 329 PMIDs) shows each 2019-2023 entrant at Temple from his/her entry year: Keith 2019, Nguyen 2020, Daly 2021, Gearhart 2023, Gonzalez 2023; NPPES enumeration dates match (Keith 2019-03, Nguyen 2020-03, Gearhart 2022-04, Gonzalez 2023-04; Daly student NPI 2019-07 Minneapolis). No other resident surfaced: other Temple-neurosurgery-affiliated authors 2018-2024 are faculty/research staff (Vance, Qaiser, Nizamutdinov, Harris, Feng, Wu, Murillo = neurology DO) or medical students (Sulhan = TAMU student then Houston Methodist resident 2020+; Ajala, Bhenderu = TAMU students, NPI 2024 elsewhere; Hernandez, Danka = BCM-Temple students). Every entry class 2014-2023 has exactly one resident (complement 1/yr), each class continuous from entry to 2024-25 or graduation, so an unseen entrant who left would have had to be an above-complement extra or be replaced mid-stream; no evidence of either. The five 2019-2023 entrants were therefore reconstructed into 2019-20..2022-23.
